digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflow (_optionality.yml) and test suite parity
propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml consumes a concurrent slot but provides redundant coverage already delivered by the four-cell test matrix in _build-and-test.yml.

Deletion of the import-linter job risks future contributors adding markers or moving files that would silently break optionality checks, because no existing test visibility covers _optionality.yml inner jobs.

A durable collection guard test must be added to assert the two optionality files remain collected under the default suite selection, catching any future marker additions or paths filters that would exclude them.
The stale 'import-linter' check context in infra/github/main-protection.snapshot.json must be removed to prevent rollback scripts from demanding a nonexistent required status check.
